title: Game notes
description: Notes on board and party games: rule history, the numbers inside the games, and building them for the browser.
blurb: Notes on board and party games: the history behind the rules, the numbers inside them, and what I learned building a few of them for the browser.
footer: Notes on board and party games by Ahmed Moaz, who builds Boardit, a free browser game site.
about: I am Ahmed Moaz, a developer in Egypt. I build Boardit, a small site of six free multiplayer browser games.

These notes are mostly about the engineering behind browser games: keeping a hidden word hidden, testing a game engine with thousands of seeded games, and the small decisions that make a page honest to search engines. Some notes are about the history and numbers inside the games themselves.
